label: Automotive Venue
description: Car-specific places: showrooms, garages, test facilities.

items.name: dealership-showroom
items.text: Inside a bright, empty, and modern car dealership showroom with polished tile floors.

items.name: wind-tunnel
items.text: Inside a high-tech wind tunnel, with visible, non-staining streamlines of smoke flowing gracefully over the car's static body.

items.name: robotic-integration-bay
items.text: A sterile, high-tech vehicle integration bay with polished floors and poised robotic arms in the background.

items.name: underground-hypercar-garage
items.text: An exclusive minimalist underground hypercar garage, with walls of obsidian-like polished stone and concrete, lit by sharp architectural light strips in the floor and ceiling.

items.name: deserted-racetrack
items.text: A deserted racetrack, with the empty grandstands and pit lane creating a lonely, silent atmosphere under stark floodlights.

items.name: modena-road
items.text: A sun-warmed road outside Modena, cypress rows and terracotta farmhouses lining the route of legends.

items.name: roman-piazza
items.text: A cobbled Roman piazza, baroque facades and fountain glow framing the parked machine.

items.name: munich-street
items.text: A clean Munich boulevard, Wilhelminian facades and linden trees flanking wide lanes.

items.name: black-forest-road
items.text: A sweeping Black Forest B-road, dense firs breaking for a valley view at the apex.

items.name: monaco-tunnel
items.text: The famous curved harbor tunnel of Monaco, sodium light rolling over the fairing walls.

items.name: goodwood-paddock
items.text: A festival hillclimb paddock, hay bales, white tents and privileged machinery in casual rows.

items.name: alpine-pass-hairpins
items.text: A high alpine pass road stacked with hairpins, stone guard walls and thin bright air.

items.name: amalfi-corniche
items.text: A cliff-hugging Amalfi corniche, pastel villages tumbling to a glittering sea below the guardrail.
